commits_before_report.message: 统一 UDP 传输命名与共享持有
统一 UDP 串行异步写入并接入 WebRTC 与 RTCP
接入 GB28181 UDP 写队列并删除会话调度
补充 UDP 写队列生命周期与会话策略测试
区分 UDP 入队拒绝与实际发送错误
补充 RTSP UDP 发布与 GB RTCP 真实协议验证

transport_contract.executor: All operations are called on the owner executor; sessions retain their existing worker dispatch/fencing.
transport_contract.write_admission: bool; span is copied, vector is moved, endpoint is stored by value.
transport_contract.write_callback: Actual send completion only; success/error + byte count. Queue admission rejection does not invoke completion.
transport_contract.overflow: Drop newest whole datagram, return false, preserve existing queue, sessions continue.
transport_contract.socket_error: Fence/clear transport writer and report actual error once; session decides shutdown.
transport_contract.single_send_in_flight: Only an empty-to-nonempty queue starts a send; completion pops its datagram and starts the next.
transport_contract.buffer_lifetime: async_send_to handler captures self and shared_ptr<pending_datagram> independently of the queue.
transport_contract.shutdown: stopped=true, clear queue/callback/byte count, cancel and close; stale completion fenced by state and datagram identity.
transport_contract.session_callbacks: Weak session references; success does not lock the session.

checks: No pending second/third datagram sent after shutdown
Transport retained until completion then released

targeted_tests.scope: Public transport wire tests and actual GB UDP sender policy; other session policies checked in source and real protocol lifecycle, without injecting private state into each protocol.

sanitizers.asan_configuration: MEDIA_SERVER_SANITIZER=address; address,undefined; O1; static Boost 1.92 ucontext with ASan; existing CMake guard passed.
sanitizers.standard_warning: ASan makecontext/swapcontext support warning remains visible; no ASan/LSan/UBSan diagnostics in successful acceptance runs.

performance.interpretation: CPU median +2.3216%, RSS -1.7222%, throughput +0.0598%, dual-track first-media p50 -1ms. No unacceptable degradation observed in this workload; 3 x 30s does not establish all workload or long-term performance.

observations.rtsp_udp_input_kernel_drops: Some RTSP UDP input suite snapshots contain kernel socket receive drops (all samples recorded above). These are not transport write queue drops. Media checks passed. No matched old-code RTSP UDP run was made, so no regression attribution is claimed.
observations.old_gb_buffer_lifetime: Old GB sender yield write referenced queue-owned packet buffers that shutdown could clear. Refactor removes this ownership-contract risk; no old-code ASan UAF reproduction is claimed.
observations.migration_error_policy: The implementation initially used no_buffer_space for overflow callbacks; admission bool now separates overflow from identical real socket errors. Fixed before final regression.
